functions.name: check_commerce_health
functions.title: Check commerce credentials status
functions.description: Reports the live connection status for Printful, Printify, Shopify and Gmail — which API secrets are configured, which resolve to a real store/shop, and which are in demo/sandbox fallback mode. Call this to verify the commerce integration configuration before testing catalog or order flows.

functions.name: read_printify_catalog
functions.title: Read Printify catalog
functions.description: Reads the LOKIN Printify store. Pass action 'shops' to list shops, 'catalog' (with shop_id) for the enriched product catalog with min/max prices, or 'product' (with shop_id + id) for a single product's variants. Returns demo-flagged sample data when the real PRINTIFY_API_TOKEN is not configured.

action.description: One of: shops, products, product, catalog. Read-only storefront reads.

shop_id.description: Printify shop id; required for products/product/catalog. Use the id returned by the 'shops' action.

id.description: Product id; required for the 'product' action.

functions.name: read_shopify_catalog
functions.title: Read Shopify catalog
functions.description: Reads the LOKIN Shopify store. Pass action 'shop' for store info, 'catalog' for the enriched product list with min/max prices, or 'product' (with id) for a single product's variants. Returns demo-flagged sample data when SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN or SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN is not configured.

action.description: One of: shop, products, product, catalog. Read-only storefront reads.

id.description: Product id; required for the 'product' action.

functions.name: read_printful_catalog
functions.title: Read Printful catalog
functions.description: Reads the LOKIN Printful store. Pass action 'store' for the resolved store info, 'products' (with store_id) for the product list, or 'product' (with store_id + id) for a single product's variants and pricing. The real PRINTFUL_API_TOKEN is already configured.

action.description: One of: store, products, product, catalog. Read-only storefront reads.

store_id.description: Printful store id; required for products/product/catalog. Use the id from the 'store' action.

id.description: Product id; required for the 'product' action.
